BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3968.name: Emerald Barrier
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A3968.effect:
[Flash]
Exhaust two opposing Spirits.
[Rush: White]
(While you have a White symbol, the following effect activates next)
[White Core]: During this turn, your Life can't be reduced by the attacks of opposing Cost 4 or more Spirits/Ultimates.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4255.name: Flying Squirrel
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4255.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
During this turn, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5275.name: Jumping Bind
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A5275.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Life is reduced)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. Or, exhaust three opposing Cost 3 or less Spirits.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6606.name: Mistral Finish
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6606.effect:
[Burst: s] (After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent)
Reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, summon any number of Green Brave cards and Green "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirit cards, without paying the cost. Return the remaining or unsummoned cards to the decktop in any order. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Return an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand. When you've done so, refresh one of your Spirits.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6823.name: Netherdwarf
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6823.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as White.

[LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
By sending a core from your Reserve to your Trash, this Spirit returns to the Hand.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6902.name: No. 46 Deer Child Island
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6902.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Main Step)
When any player would summon a Cost 5 or less Spirit card without "Imp"/"Winged Beast" family, it is summoned in exhausted state.

[LV2] (Your Core Step)
By not putting a core from the Void to your Reserve, draw a card. This effect doesn't stack.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7352.name: Rabbat
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A7352.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By sending [Soul Core](Soul Core) from this Spirit to the Trash, this Spirit returns to the Hand.

USAGI-DG.name: Rabbit Demon-God
USAGI-DG.effect:
This Brave doesn't exhaust, and while in Spirit condition, can't attack or block.

[When Braved on the Right] (When Attacks)
The opponent can't activate their Bursts.

[When Braved on the Left] (When Attacks)
By returning an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom, once per turn, refresh this Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8687.name: The BeastStriker Oo-Gangar
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8687.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
While [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, all your "Imp"/"Winged Beast" family Spirits gain +4000 BP.

[During Seal] [LV1][LV2][LV3]
All your "Imp"/"Winged Beast" family Spirits gain +8000 BP. This effect doesn't stack.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10050.name: The Fourth's HoppingBeast Rocket-Rex
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10050.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
The opponent exhausts two of their Spirits.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When it's the first attack of your turn, this Spirit refreshes.

THEYRE-JUST.name: The GreatHoppingBeast Flemishbase
THEYRE-JUST.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return three opposing exhausted Spirits to the deckbottom, in any order.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When the attack of your "Imp"/"Winged Beast" family Spirit reduces the opposing Life, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11787.name: The RabbitTwelveGodKing Mistral-Bit
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11787.effect:
Flash - [Seal: High Speed Seal]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve. When you've done so, you can send the [Soul Core] from any of your Spirits to your Life.

[Seal: During Seal] [LV2][LV3] [Leap] (When Attacks/Blocks)
By returning an opposing exhausted Spirit to the Hand, send an opposing Life to their Reserve, and put a core from the Void each to every "God-King"/"Ten Crown" family Spirit you control.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12157.name: The Second's HoppingBeast Droplop
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12157.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
By sending a core from your Reserve to your Trash, this Spirit returns to the Hand.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12404.name: The Sixth's HoppingBeastEmperor Lio-Bit
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12404.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Imp"/"Winged Beast" family Spirit attacks, the opponent can't block unless they block with two Spirits or two Ultimates. When that Spirit is blocked, choose one of them to battle against.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By paying one cost, return one of your "Imp"/"Winged Beast" family Spirits to the Hand.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12995.name: The Tenth's SpearBeast Yariarashi
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A12995.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as White.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your End Step)
This Spirit refreshes.

[LV2][LV3] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the deckbottom.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14366.name: Wild Ride
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14366.effect:
During (Your End Step), return a [Wild Ride] from your Trash to the Hand. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[Flash]
During this turn, give one of your Spirits +3000 BP, and the effect:"(When Attacks/Blocks) When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by BP comparison, this Spirit refreshes."
